Given two [[vector|vectors]]

$$
\vec{u}=\sum_i u_i \vec{e}_i,\qquad
\vec{v}=\sum_j v_j \vec{e}_j,
$$

Their '''outer product'''

$$
\vec{u} \otimes \vec{v}
=
(a_{ij}=u_i v_j)
$$

is a matrice of dimension $\dim(\vec u) \times \dim(\vec v)$

== Example ==

For $\vec{u},\vec{v}\in\mathbb{R}^3$

$$
\vec{u} \otimes \vec{v}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
u_1 v_1 & u_1 v_2 & u_1 v_3 \\
u_2 v_1 & u_2 v_2 & u_2 v_3 \\
u_3 v_1 & u_3 v_2 & u_3 v_3
\end{pmatrix}.
$$
